sloka: हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनो भास्करो रविः ।अग्निगर्भो ऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः ।। ६.१०७.१२ ।।
transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śiśirastapano bhāskaro raviḥ ।agnigarbho 'diteḥ putraḥ śaṅkhaḥ śiśiranāśanaḥ ।। 6.107.12 ।।

translations.english: "You have the golden cosmic egg in the womb, you are cool, you are the purifier, the ruler of all, bringer of day, who Bears the fire of dissolution in the womb. You are the son of Aditi, blissful personified and destroyer of cold.
translations.hindi: इनके पास उनके भाई लक्ष्मण बैसे ही खड़ द, जैसे विष्चु के साथ इन्द्र । ( उस समय ) वे अपने ।<राल घलुष को उठाए सानो आकाश को स्पर्श कर रहे थे
